verdict.rationale: The hosted API is exposed under a versioned path prefix (e.g. /v1/plans), so URL-level API versioning exists. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or compatibility guarantees. The Needle generation=2 option pins a model version, not an API version, so it does not count as a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning and compatibility guarantees, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
